slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

slots.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
slots.author: CoinDesk
slots.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

slots.title: Sequoia shutting down its Scouts program marks the end of an era
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: Sequoia pioneered the scouts model and many VC firms followed suit, but a consensus now seems to be forming that the model has reached limits in its current form.

slots.title: From the front row to the hot seat — what the midterms mean for Big Tech
slots.author: TechCrunch
slots.summary: After spending two years getting cozy with the White House, Big Tech is suddenly trying to make friends with Democrats, and the open question is whether that image makeover can hold up against what states, local communities, and the markets are about to do.

slots.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.
